tools.name: linktree_get_profile_info
tools.description: Retrieve system-level information about the Linktree profile being viewed: username, verification status, profile badges, and the public profile URL. Useful when an agent needs context about who the page belongs to.

tools.name: linktree_share_profile
tools.description: Return the public URL of this Linktree profile and copy it to the clipboard when possible. Use this when the user asks to share, send, or copy the profile.

tools.name: linktree_subscribe_open
tools.description: Open the follow/subscribe modal on this Linktree profile — the same modal the profile Subscribe button opens. Action-only: it never submits a follow or subscription; the visitor completes the flow inside the opened modal.
